selection: Apply the user-selected fixed agreement scoring rule from the second exploratory fusion run. No score coefficients or model hyperparameters are tuned on the test rows.
scope: AIT 6/1/1 and 4/2/2, 8 folds and 5 seeds each. Same 811 current features, and host profile 124, pooled legacy entity 124, direct entity 78. Three model scores are combined after each model's original local-score path. Separate AutoLabel and CERT interface experiments do not use this AIT-specific ensemble.
comparators: Under all eight combinations of state, CF and local evidence, compute the corresponding agreement score. Off-state uses matching current-only scorer. Off-CF replaces every edited row by its natural parent with the same weights. Off-local turns off both local heads and context residuals before fusion. Recover existing valid scores or fit missing host or legacy matched arms only. Outage routing uses host and redesigned-entity fallbacks and the original mask scheme.
evaluation: Lock all 80 fold validation scores and operating cutoffs before score replay and test. Assert full score equals prior agreement exactly, and verify using separately frozen results locally. Report AP, Recall@1% FPR and scene-paired analysis. Main results remain exploratory within the eight previously used scenes. Compare to the host neural blend where evaluated.
